extraArgs.description: Additional arguments on the output Deployment definition.

extraEnv.description:
Additional environments variables on the output Deployment definition.
For extra OLLAMA env, please refer to https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/envconfig/config.go
- name: OLLAMA_DEBUG
value: "1"

extraEnvFrom.description:
Additionl environment variables from external sources (like ConfigMap)
- configMapRef:
name: my-env-configmap

extraObjects.description:
Extra K8s manifests to deploy
- apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
name: aws-efs
data:
key: "value"
- apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
name: high-priority
value: 1000000
globalDefault: false
description: "This priority class should be used for XYZ service pods only."

tag.description: Docker image tag, overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: Docker registry secret names as an array

ingress.description: Configure the ingress resource that allows you to access the

initContainers.description:
Init containers to add to the pod
- name: startup-tool
image: alpine:3
command: [sh, -c]
args:
- echo init

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Time to keep completed Knative model bootstrap Jobs before cleanup. Set to null to disable TTL-based cleanup.

responseStartTimeoutSeconds.description: Knative service response start timeout seconds

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle for pod assignment (override ollama.models startup pull/run)

livenessProbe.description:
Configure extra options for liveness probe
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-probes/#configure-probes

nameOverride.description: String to partially override template  (will maintain the release name)

number.description:
Specify the number of GPU
If you use MIG section below then this parameter is ignored

nvidiaResource.description:
only for nvidia cards; change to (example) 'nvidia.com/mig-1g.10gb' to use MIG slice
nvidiaResource: "nvidia.com/mig-1g.10gb" # example
If you want to use more than one NVIDIA MIG you can use the following syntax (then nvidiaResource is ignored and only the configuration in the following MIG section is used)

type.description:
GPU type: 'nvidia' or 'amd'
If 'ollama.gpu.enabled', default value is nvidia
If set to 'amd', this will add 'rocm' suffix to image tag if 'image.tag' is not override
This is due cause AMD and CPU/CUDA are different images

persistentVolume.description:
Enable persistence using Persistent Volume Claims
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/

podAnnotations.description: Map of annotations to add to the pods

podLabels.description: Map of labels to add to the pods

readinessProbe.description:
Configure extra options for readiness probe
ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-probes/#configure-probes

resources.description:
Configure resource requests and limits
ref: http://kubernetes.io/docs/user-guide/compute-resources/

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old ReplicaSets to retain for rollback. Default is 10.

securityContext.description:
Container Security Context
capabilities:
drop:
- ALL
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology Spread Constraints for pod assignment

volumeMounts.description: Additional volumeMounts on the output Deployment definition.

volumes.description: Additional volumes on the output Deployment definition.
